chunks: The mention of the matter of Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi, the nephew of the Sheikh Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Uthman al-Amiri, and Abu Dalf al-Majnun:

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Uthman al-Amiri

ai.seo_question: Who was Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi in relation to Sheikh Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Uthman?
ai.summary: This heading introduces the narrative of Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi, a key figure among the *al-Sufyaniyya* or early claimants to the Imamate, whose lineage connects him to the trusted scribe of the Imams, Sheikh Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Uthman al-Amiri. The mention of Abu Dalf al-Majnun alongside him highlights the diverse social strata and varying degrees of credibility among those who falsely asserted deputyship during the Minor and Major Ghaiba, serving as a cautionary example of *taqiyya* and authenticating the Imams' specific condemnations of such pretenders.
